context: Compose song lyrics about a socio-economic problem. The song should be in English and in all lowercase letters.

trace.content:
the rent is due again today
but the check is still a week away
the landlord knocks with heavy feet
while i count coins beneath my seat

the grocery store is full of light
but i can only buy the night
the price of bread has gone so high
i watch the hungry children cry

they say the market's doing well
but i can't afford to tell
the story of the empty shelf
the struggle of the working self

the gap is wide, the bridge is gone
we walk alone until the dawn
a system built on broken backs
while others fill their golden sacks

we need a change, we need a hand
to fix the cracks across the land
before the silence turns to stone
and we are left to face it alone
